title: A team participating of one or more challenges concept (OpenEBench Benchmarking Data Model schemas 2.0)
$comment: allOf and placeholders inspired by https://stackoverflow.com/a/24365393

_id.title: The unique id of the participant team, according to the rules

_schema.title: The JSON schema absolute URI. It must match the value of '$id' in the JSON schema

references.title: The participant team reference id(s) (if any)

links.title: Ways to contact the participant team responsible. It can be many different ones: public page, a social media link, some public chat, a public mailing list, ...

name.title: Short participant team name (only valid within the scope of the benchmarking event)

description.title: Optional, long description of the participant team, written in Markdown

benchmarking_event_id.title: The parent benchmarking event where all the challenges where the team is going to participate

enrolled_challenge_ids.description: The challenges where this time has been enrolled

tool_id.title: The id of the tool used by the participants. It is optional (only required for engagement level 3), because there could be teams without their own public tools/implementations

team_members.title: The members of the team, along their role(s)
